verdict.rationale: Unit's docs describe both a Dashboard and APIs giving access to the same customer/account/payment/card data (unit-docs-5) and note that API-first and managed/dashboard approaches run on the same core infrastructure (unit-docs-22), implying API-UI parity by design. However, there is no explicit statement or reference that every UI action (e.g., in Managed Solutions Dashboard) has a corresponding API endpoint, and probes show the OpenAPI spec and docs pages returning 404s, so full parity can't be verified. Missing for 10: explicit API-UI parity documentation, working OpenAPI reference, and independent/hands-on confirmation that dashboard-only actions are also API-accessible.
